core_obligations: H3: Equivariant virtual localisation and the explicit all-genus Gromov-Witten decorated-graph formula for Hamiltonian GKM manifolds. Given the cited global charts and ordinary torus localisation, the author constructs compatible equivariant charts/fixed suborbifolds and identifies their moving obstruction/normal pieces. An intermediate chart with constrained domain topology separates map and domain deformations; graph automorphism quotients, normalised component sequences, moving automorphisms and node-smoothing factors yield the actual Euler-class ratio and graph weights. Ordinary localisation alone does not compute this ratio. Count general virtual localisation with its complete GKM computation and immediate graph-determination/toric corollaries as one author framework, not a problem per graph factor.
